purpose: Recover only the already-registered REG.RU pc-prod GitHub Actions runner after a lost-communication incident, through the existing pinned production SSH identity, without touching application runtime, Docker objects, databases, model runtime or customer data.
approvedBy: repository-owner direct continuation of Gekta SPEED #3896 and protected REG.RU release authority on 2026-08-14
requiredBehavior: owner-only command is bound to issue 3365 and the exact literal /tai recover-pc-prod-runner current-main
execute from a GitHub-hosted runner through the existing protected REG.RU root SSH key and pinned host fingerprint
resolve and record exact current main immediately before recovery
require exactly one pre-existing pc-prod actions.runner systemd service and require its configured user to be pcactions
perform only a bounded restart of that existing runner service and require it to return active
prove the running pcactions process has no Docker supplementary group and that pcactions has no direct Docker socket authority
collect read-only available-space counters for Docker and containerd filesystems so the interrupted headroom reclaim can be classified safely
publish only bounded runner state, capacity counters and the GitHub run URL
forbiddenCapabilities: runner registration re-registration removal or registration-token consumption
creating a new runner service runner directory user group or package installation
changing the release controller sudoers known_hosts runner labels or runner configuration
docker pull push prune rm rmi system prune image prune builder prune container volume or network mutation
application deployment rollback restart or configuration mutation
database model-host deal role money registration credential or customer-data mutation
unbounded remote shell input or user-controlled remote command arguments
new server paid API SaaS or recurring cost
